m4_decode.title: Mac decode speed: what each option adds
m4_decode.device: Apple M4 Pro (10 performance cores), 48 GiB, macOS; liyab-cli, CPU backend, greedy, 'performance' profile. Draft runs: a code-copy task, plain-file weights.
m4_decode.notes: --requant 4 lowers the feed-forward and query/output matrices to Q4_K at load (lossy, KL 0.007-0.0085 on the 14B). Text drafts: 14B 18.9 -> 29.1, 27B 12.5 -> 16.5 on the same task; free text gains nothing. 14B code edit with drafts and --requant 4: 42.9.

m4_prefill.notes: Automatic routing picks Metal for prompts and the CPU for decoding; its decision is kept in cache_dir (14B: 143 tok/s on the first run, 158-163 after).
